teacher_info.about_teacher:
My teaching began when I started teaching my overseas clients English pronunciation lessons because they told me they never had a chance to speak English at school with a native.
This became a weekly class in the Starbucks cafe and this is where my lesson format emerged.
I focus on helping students sound good, like a native and use methods to help their tongue and mind get around common difficulties.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
The lessons usually start with a 10-15 minute conversation of what is happening in the students life.
From that I will understand their level. I may take a news article to read together and discuss the way it is presented, written and spoken. That usually last 15-20 minutes. After that I will look at phrases and groups of words that can be pronounced together. Normally this entire lesson would be about 40-60mins depending on how the discussion goes. 
I can give the student some tasks or exercises to practise before the next lesson that will help them sound better.

Do you get tongue-tied with the conditionals or past tenses? Do you need to review the modal verbs and their meanings and use? 

We can focus the classes on pronunciation, fluency or accuracy, brush up on a grammar point or do a bit of everything and I can give you materials to study at home with extra vocabulary or grammar points, such as articles, videos or worksheets. pro_course_detail.title: Speak with Confidence: Fluency Building English Classes
pro_course_detail.description:
What can students expect to learn from these lessons?
Students will gain the confidence to speak English fluently in everyday situations. Each lesson is tailored to help you express your thoughts clearly and naturally, enhancing your speaking skills through practical, real-life scenarios.

Is this class focused on a textbook or test?
This class does not rely on a single textbook or aim at preparing for specific tests. Instead, it focuses on practical speaking skills through interactive and dynamic content.

What is the main focus of the lesson?
The primary focus is on building speaking confidence and fluency. We'll work on pronunciation, vocabulary relevant to daily conversations, and the natural flow of speech, ensuring you can communicate effectively in English.

What teaching methods and materials will you use?
I use a communicative approach where learning happens through speaking. Materials include custom conversation prompts, role-plays, and current media clips (like TV or news excerpts) to discuss, which not only keeps the content engaging but also relevant. We'll also incorporate some light grammar points where necessary, but always in the context of speaking practice. 

The lessons are interactive, encouraging students to speak as much as possible, with immediate feedback to correct mistakes and reinforce learning.

Why choose this class?
If you're looking to break free from the confines of traditional learning and dive into real-world speaking, this class is for you. We'll create a supportive environment where making mistakes is part of the learning process, helping you to feel more confident and fluent in your English speaking skills. 

Join for a trial lesson and see how you can transform your English speaking abilities!
